text: {"lessons":["A 4.8% monthly decline showed that my savings can fluctuate, so I should keep the portfolio diversified and avoid taking more risk than my retirement needs allow.","Selling Stock D at a steep loss did not stop the account from later recovering; I should make decisions based on current prospects and my plan, not on my purchase price or a wish to recoup losses.","I made few trades while the account recovered over subsequent periods, which is a reminder not to trade just to react to short-term changes; I should review calmly and keep enough cash for living needs."]}
